scenarios.name: normal
scenarios.description: Normal boot: loader verifies and loads the kernel, kernel validates boot info, TEST PASS.

patterns: ^NANOX: vmm ok root=0x[0-9a-f]+ physmap=0xffff800000000000 .* text=r-x rodata=r-- data=rw- guards=4 null=unmapped$

scenarios.name: fail
scenarios.description: Kernel reports a deliberate test failure (nanox.test=fail).

scenarios.name: unknown-test
scenarios.description: Unknown nanox.test value is a test failure, not a silent pass.

scenarios.name: panic
scenarios.description: Kernel panic path (nanox.test=panic).

scenarios.name: hang
scenarios.description: Kernel halts forever; only the harness timeout ends the run.

scenarios.name: missing-kernel
scenarios.description: KERNEL.ELF absent from the ESP.

scenarios.name: corrupt-kernel
scenarios.description: One byte of KERNEL.ELF flipped after the manifest was written.

scenarios.name: framebuffer
scenarios.description: Canonical config plus one VGA device: exercises the optional framebuffer fields.

scenarios.name: missing-initrd
scenarios.description: INITRD.IMG absent from the ESP.

scenarios.name: corrupt-initrd
scenarios.description: One byte of INITRD.IMG flipped after the manifest was written.

scenarios.name: bad-initrd
scenarios.description: Initramfs that matches the manifest but is not a cpio archive (150 bytes of text): rejected by the kernel.

image.initrd_text: NANOX test: this text is not a cpio newc archive. NANOX test: this text is not a cpio newc archive. NANOX test: this text is not a cpio newc archive.

patterns: ^NANOX: PANIC initramfs invalid: E_MAGIC at offset 0$

scenarios.name: ud
scenarios.description: Deliberate #UD (ud2) must be caught by the kernel IDT and reported.

scenarios.name: gp
scenarios.description: Deliberate #GP (load through a non-canonical address).

scenarios.name: divzero
scenarios.description: Deliberate #DE (division by zero).

scenarios.name: pagefault
scenarios.description: Deliberate write to an address the kernel never maps: #PF with verifiable diagnostics.

patterns: ^NANOX: EXCEPTION #PF present=0 write=1 user=0 reserved=0 fetch=0$

scenarios.name: nullderef
scenarios.description: Read through a null pointer: the null page is not mapped.

scenarios.name: wprotect
scenarios.description: Write to .rodata: mapped read-only, CR0.WP set.

patterns: ^NANOX: EXCEPTION #PF present=1 write=1 user=0 reserved=0 fetch=0$
^NANOX: EXCEPTION #PF mapping va=0x[0-9a-f]+ pa=0x[0-9a-f]+ size=4K perms=r--$

scenarios.name: nxexec
scenarios.description: Jump into writable data: mapped non-executable (EFER.NXE).

patterns: ^NANOX: EXCEPTION #PF present=1 write=0 user=0 reserved=0 fetch=1$
^NANOX: EXCEPTION #PF mapping va=0x[0-9a-f]+ pa=0x[0-9a-f]+ size=4K perms=rw-$

scenarios.name: stackoverflow
scenarios.description: Unbounded recursion hits the unmapped guard page below the boot stack; #DF on its IST stack.

patterns: ^NANOX: EXCEPTION stack overflow: guard page of stack boot hit at 0x[0-9a-f]+$

scenarios.name: doublefree
scenarios.description: Freeing a page twice: the physical allocator refuses and the kernel panics.

patterns: ^NANOX: PANIC pmm: free of page 0x[0-9a-f]+ rejected: E_DOUBLE_FREE$
